SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p90_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS distinct_investigator_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_reference_count, MIN(TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(TO_DATE(a.award_expiration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.code::integer JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.code::integer WHERE a.award_amount > 5049827.32 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_expiration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 50350705.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 8.4 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, a.award_instrument, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_month, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id, o.directorate, a.award_instrument ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '3 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3month_award_sum, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id, o.directorate, a.award_instrument ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 months' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_6month_award_avg, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id, o.directorate, a.award_instrument ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_1year_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code::character varying = pe.code JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code::character varying = pr.code WHERE a.award_amount > 11322.7 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, a.award_instrument, a.award_amount, DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ORDER BY rolling_3month_award_sum DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7296289.96 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 16599404.96 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 979685.55 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3484718.35 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4332348.51 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) >= 64.55 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award_title, '; ' ORDER BY a.award_title) AS award_titles FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 2538751.52 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 26180285.31 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT AVG(a2.award_amount) FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.organisation_code = o.code AND a2.award_amount > 4622891.24) AS avg_org_award_above_threshold FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 48863603.53 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 288334.13) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1886663.65 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT award_id FROM awards WHERE award_amount > 966507.97)) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2089784.86 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7710434.08 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2140492.76 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, f.name AS foa_name, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_rank_in_state, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate, o.division) AS avg_award_by_division FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 6639576.87 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, f.name, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 30.04 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_rank_in_state;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.code AS organization_code, o.division, o.directorate, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pe.text AS program_element_text, pr.code AS program_reference_code, pr.text AS program_reference_text, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards_per_institution, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS total_amount_by_state, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate) AS avg_amount_by_directorate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 5310553.51 AND (a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' OR a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01') AND (i.state_code = 'AL' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards ia2 JOIN investigator inv ON ia2.email_id = inv.id WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI' )) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.code, o.division, o.directorate, f.code, f.name, pe.code, pe.text, pr.code, pr.text HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2343792.06 ORDER BY total_amount_by_state DESC, award_amount_rank;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS investigator_count_by_role FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 1941801.45 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IS NOT NULL AND o.directorate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code, o.directorate, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 9.47 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code AS organization_code, org.directorate, foa.code AS foa_code, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_reference_code, ia.name AS institution_award_name, ia.zipcode AS institution_award_zip, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS state_award_running_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY org.directorate) AS directorate_avg_award, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS state_award_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info foa ON fia.code = foa.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 283939.26 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code, org.directorate, foa.code, pe.code, pr.code, ia.name, ia.zipcode HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1284935.09 ORDER BY state_award_running_total DESC, state_award_rank;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS num_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr_a.code) AS num_program_references, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.division) AS state_division_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code WHERE a.award_amount > 1103698.37 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inv_a JOIN investigator inv ON inv_a.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id WHERE inv_a.award_id = a.award_id AND inv_a.role_code = 'PI' AND inv_a.start_date <= '2000-01-01' AND (inv_a.end_date IS NULL OR inv_a.end_date >= '2000-01-01') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM program_element_awards pe_a2 WHERE pe_a2.award_id = a.award_id AND pe_a2.code = 6475.59 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, fi.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) > 0.59 AND AVG(a.award_amount) > 115156.77 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_amount_rank;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank_by_total FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 4734939.29 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 11194192.62 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) > 5488722.73 THEN 'High Value' WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 335560.5 AND 831713.98 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS funding_category FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 26.05 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, o.division) AS country_division_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS pi_count, (SELECT MAX(a2.award_amount) FROM awards a2 JOIN institution_awards ia3 ON a2.award_id = ia3.award_id WHERE ia3.id = i.id AND a2.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01') AS institution_max_recent_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 4178845.36 AND a.award_effective_date >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.directorate, o.division, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 2.47 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_max_recent_award DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, org.directorate, org.division, foa.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr_a.code) AS program_reference_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.email_id) AS investigator_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, org.division) AS country_division_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards iaw ON i.id = iaw.id JOIN awards a ON iaw.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info foa ON fia.code = foa.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7473196.94 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ( SELECT DISTINCT state_code FROM institution WHERE country_name = 'United States' AND state_code IS NOT NULL AND state_code IN ( SELECT state_code FROM institution GROUP BY state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) > 98.07 ) ) AND org.directorate IN ( SELECT directorate FROM organization WHERE division IN ( SELECT division FROM organization GROUP BY division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT code) > 12.62 ) ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, org.directorate, org.division, foa.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.email_id) > 1.56 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 383928.26 ORDER BY award_amount_rank, state_directorate_total DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount, AVG(a.arra_amount) AS avg_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_names, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_element_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_reference_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigator_emails, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_effective_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 1946562.97 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code, o.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 24.3 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 73133987.38 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_directorate FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 7359287.44 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 49913220.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 39.4 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(pe.code, pr.code)) AS distinct_program_combos, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(a.award_amount) AS max_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 7368802.4 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2306941.85 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS unique_investigator_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS directorate_rank, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE))) AS prev_state_total FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inv_a ON a.award_id = inv_a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inv_a.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 2356230.72 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2005-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 27231469.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 65.78 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS unique_investigator_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS unique_program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS unique_program_reference_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS directorate_rank_by_total, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY o.directorate, org.division) AS prev_total_in_state_dir_div FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN organization org ON o.code = org.code AND o.directorate = org.directorate WHERE a.award_amount > 7843714 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2005-01-01' AND inva.start_date >= '2000-01-01' AND inva.end_date <= '2005-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') AND o.directorate NOT LIKE '%Test%' AND fi.name ILIKE '%Research%' AND a.award_instrument = 'Grant' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, org.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 37 AND SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 98918994 AND 350913793 AND AVG(a.award_amount) > 399930 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC LIMIT 59;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.arra_amount) AS avg_arra_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate, i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigators FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN organization org ON o.code = org.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 6448880.27 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, org.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 16936216.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 5.16 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code WHERE a.award_amount > 382431.33 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2672465.84 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id1, i2.id AS institution_id2, i1.state_code AS state1, i2.state_code AS state2, oa.directorate, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_effective_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization oa ON a.organisation_code = oa.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id WHERE i1.id <> i2.id AND a.award_amount > 4339053.26 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2005-01-01' AND i1.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.state_code, i2.state_code, oa.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 74.27 AND SUM(a.arra_amount) < 2002298.26 ORDER BY total_arra_amount DESC, avg_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id_1, i2.id AS institution_id_2, i1.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) AS shared_award_count, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_shared_award_amount FROM institution i1 JOIN institution i2 ON i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND i1.id < i2.id JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON i2.id = ia2.id AND ia1.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3420271.87 GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) >= 71.67 ORDER BY shared_award_count DESC, avg_shared_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id_1, i2.id AS institution_id_2, i1.state_code, i1.country_name, o.directorate, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code, o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_dir_rank, LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE))) AS prev_award_count FROM institution i1 JOIN institution i2 ON i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND i1.country_name = i2.country_name AND i1.id < i2.id JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON i2.id = ia2.id AND a.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 3908609.13 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate LIKE 'ENG' GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.state_code, i1.country_name, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4138987.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 98.72 ORDER BY total_arra_amount DESC, avg_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i_a.id AS institution_id, i_a.name AS institution_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i_a.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_amount FROM institution_awards i_a JOIN awards a ON i_a.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 470270.8 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i_a.id, i_a.name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date ORDER BY i_a.id, a.award_effective_date;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 307397.73 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4504739.8 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 9048650.38 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.id IN ( SELECT ia2.id FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN awards a2 ON ia2.award_id = a2.award_id WHERE a2.award_amount > 2143993.31 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 41325650.63 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 256834.1 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2110703.43 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 50835.25 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3649495.5 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.email_id = i.contact AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS pi_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 590818.49 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.contact HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2408858.29 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 790877.22) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 115824.13 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 579883.31 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2005-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3469262.98 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_award_sum FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3116049.43 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, a.award_amount ORDER BY i.id, a.award_effective_date;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, f.name AS foa_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.email_id IN (SELECT ia3.email_id FROM investigator_awards ia3 WHERE ia3.award_id = a.award_id AND ia3.role_code = 'PI') ) AS investigator_collaboration_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 4851954 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND (i.state_code = 'CA' OR i.state_code IS NULL) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, f.name, a.award_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 3 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_amount_rank;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_avg FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 254561.01 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_id IN ( SELECT ia2.award_id FROM investigator_awards ia2 JOIN investigator inv ON ia2.email_id = inv.id WHERE ia2.role_code = 'PI' AND ia2.start_date >= '2010-01-01' ) AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 4.36 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 2647111.32 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.organisation_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) > 10000000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 1000000 AND 10000000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS funding_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_locations, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigators, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 3671313.1 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.organisation_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 36806217.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 24.54 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, a.award_instrument) AS country_instrument_avg, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT inv_a.email_id) FROM investigator_awards inv_a WHERE inv_a.award_id = a.award_id AND inv_a.role_code = 'PI') AS investigator_count_by_role FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 1210619.6 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, o.directorate, o.division, f.name, a.award_instrument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 13.72 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 27135617.3 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, country_instrument_avg DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 1158342.36 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 31694901.21 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_award_names, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigators, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_directorate, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY o.directorate, o.division) AS prev_state_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 5013048.78 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND inva.start_date >= '2000-01-01' AND inva.end_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 95.87 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 80691538.43 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.city_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding_in_directorate FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 2515485.6 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.city_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 45588453.42 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3419195.26 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.id IN ( SELECT ia2.id FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN awards a2 ON ia2.award_id = a2.award_id WHERE a2.award_amount > ( SELECT AVG(a3.award_amount) FROM awards a3 WHERE a3.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 5851849.76 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_amount, i.city_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount > 302680.68 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_amount, i.city_name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) > 3.47 UNION SELECT a.award_id, a.award_amount, i.city_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount < 29584.84 AND a.award_effective_date <= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_amount, i.city_name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) < 5.46 ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator i ON inva.email_id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount > 4905067.13 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM program_element_awards pea WHERE pea.award_id = a.award_id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 337.67 ) GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) > 4.15 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, i.name AS institution_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia WHERE ia.award_id = a.award_id AND ia.role_code = 'PI') AS investigator_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards iaw ON a.award_id = iaw.award_id JOIN institution i ON iaw.id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount > 320522.85 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, i.name ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, i.name AS institution_name, o.directorate FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 8849873.6 AND a.award_id IN ( SELECT award_id FROM investigator_awards WHERE start_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY award_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT email_id) >= 1.34 ) GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, i.name, o.directorate ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 6356726.96 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 24890774.07 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.directorate, ', ' ORDER BY o.directorate) AS directorate_list FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 6231335.23 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 23634353.93 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 5451651.69 GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 36239994.64 UNION ALL SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.arra_amount > 3031308.11 GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > 61.9 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 9549525.54 GROUP BY i.id, i.name UNION ALL SELECT o.code AS org_code, o.directorate AS org_directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount FROM organization o JOIN awards a ON o.code = a.organisation_code WHERE a.arra_amount > 1740441.83 GROUP BY o.code, o.directorate ORDER BY award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 5350517.83 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2160290.24 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub.award_amount) FROM awards sub WHERE sub.award_amount > 155998.19) AS avg_award_above_threshold FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1520415.17 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 301291.18) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 98767.78 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.email_id) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id IN (SELECT ia3.award_id FROM institution_awards ia3 WHERE ia3.id = i.id AND ia3.award_id >= 581498)) AS total_investigators FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount >= 5982160 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4866494 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(SUM(a.award_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 225244.89 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 719830.7 ORDER BY i.state_code, award_year DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, f.name AS foa_name, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_avg, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.email_id = ia.email_id AND ia2.start_date >= '2000-01-01') AS investigator_active_awards_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards iaw ON i.id = iaw.id JOIN awards a ON iaw.award_id = a.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 1065607.62 AND a.award_effective_date >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, f.name, o.directorate, o.division, ia.email_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 5.6 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id, award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code AS organization_code, org.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS program_element_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS state_avg_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pe_a.code::character varying = pe.code JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pr_a.code::character varying = pr.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inv_a ON a.award_id = inv_a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inv_a.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id WHERE a.award_amount > 8350455.62 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards a2 JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a2.award_id = ia2.award_id WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND a2.award_amount > 3039547.04 ORDER BY a2.award_amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 49 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code, org.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) > 2 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT a.award_title, '; ') AS award_titles FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 2215209.59 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4306608.56 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 140151.66)) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1405716.17 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 426118.56) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'CA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3543227.85 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 563632.17) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 154806.47 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 274496.23 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1360769.71 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS investigator_count_by_role FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 5309827.98 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IS NOT NULL AND o.directorate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code, o.directorate, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 2.17 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code AS organization_code, org.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS program_element_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS state_avg_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pe_a.code::character varying = pe.code JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pr_a.code::character varying = pr.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inv_a ON a.award_id = inv_a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inv_a.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3939933.2 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM awards a2 JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a2.award_id = ia2.award_id WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND a2.award_amount > 2618832.66 ORDER BY a2.award_amount DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 36 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.code, org.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) > 1 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS num_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS num_program_references, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.division) AS state_division_avg FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 6712326.8 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva2 WHERE inva2.award_id = a.award_id AND inva2.role_code = 'PI') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foa_info_awards fia2 WHERE fia2.award_id = a.award_id AND fia2.code IN (SELECT code FROM foa_info WHERE name LIKE '%Research%'))) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 7.92 OR AVG(a.award_amount) > 2353784.29 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, a.award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS state_average_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code WHERE a.award_amount > 3723261.8 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_id IN ( SELECT ia2.award_id FROM investigator_awards ia2 JOIN investigator inv ON ia2.email_id = inv.id WHERE ia2.role_code = 'PI' AND ia2.start_date >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 30.65 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 2098316.8 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 6987106.99 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 17895129.02 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigator_count, MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(a.max_amd_letter_date FROM 1 FOR 10) AS DATE)) AS latest_amendment_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 11324779.49 AND CAST(SUBSTRING(a.award_effective_date FROM 1 FOR 10) AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 999472302.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 487.89 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS unique_investigators, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_dir_rank, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE))) AS prev_award_total FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 357399.59 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2005-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') AND o.directorate LIKE 'ENG' AND inva.role_code = 'PI' AND (a.arra_amount IS NULL OR a.arra_amount < 493983.83) AND (pe.text IS NULL OR pe.text ILIKE '%research%') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 39.79 AND SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 97690172.88 AND 34216605.47 AND AVG(a.award_amount) > 828775.59 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id, i.name, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 260423116.84 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.zipcode, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 1796642.79 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code, i.zipcode HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > 19.24 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS inst_id1, i1.name AS inst_name1, i1.state_code AS inst_state1, i2.id AS inst_id2, i2.name AS inst_name2, i2.state_code AS inst_state2, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.arra_amount) AS avg_arra_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank_by_amount FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id WHERE a.award_amount > 2789521.15 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2005-01-01' AND i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND i1.id <> i2.id AND iva.role_code = 'PI' GROUP BY i1.id, i1.name, i1.state_code, i2.id, i2.name, i2.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 22.81 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 55129.4 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id, i1.name AS institution_name, i2.id AS related_institution_id, i2.name AS related_institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) AS shared_award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_shared_award_amount FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON ia1.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id WHERE i1.id < i2.id AND a.award_amount > 5746026.8 GROUP BY i1.id, i1.name, i2.id, i2.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) >= 98.33 ORDER BY shared_award_count DESC, total_shared_award_amount DESC;

JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.arra_amount > 3355933.96 AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title, i.state_code HAVING
