SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i LEFT JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id LEFT JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 1461423.05 GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(ia.award_id) < 31.79 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i LEFT JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id LEFT JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4199970.27 OR a.award_amount IS NULL GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(ia.award_id) < 17.51 ORDER BY award_count ASC, total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 2656984.16 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR i.country_name = 'A') AND NOT (o.division = 'A') AND a.award_effective_date >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 8072894.06 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, o.code AS organization_code, o.division, o.directorate, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_reference_code, a.award_instrument, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS unique_investigators, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(inv.first_name, ' ', inv.last_name), '; SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS num_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS num_program_references, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.division) AS state_division_avg FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 742056.97 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01') AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva2 WHERE inva2.award_id = a.award_id AND inva2.role_code = 'PI') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foa_info_awards fia2 WHERE fia2.award_id = a.award_id AND fia2.code IN (SELECT code FROM foa_info WHERE name LIKE '%Research%'))) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 6.51 OR AVG(a.award_amount) > 3684908.04 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, a.award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 9122650.48 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 29127857.92 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI' ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4137943.84 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 555063.81 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(a.award_amount) AS max_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 6577262.8 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR i.country_name = 'CountryA') AND NOT (o.division = 'DivA') AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 75.3 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3906382.89 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 25464131.88 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4594147.07 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.id IN ( SELECT ia2.id FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN awards a2 ON ia2.award_id = a2.award_id WHERE a2.award_amount > 9452596.96 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 92815029.35 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 3318245.18 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 883495.92 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 2125756.71 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3351138.16 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT AVG(sub.award_amount) FROM awards sub WHERE sub.award_amount > 937003.18) AS avg_award_above_threshold FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3080916.52 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, org.directorate, org.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, org.division) AS country_division_avg, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT inv_a.email_id) FROM investigator_awards inv_a WHERE inv_a.award_id = a.award_id AND inv_a.role_code = 'PI') AS investigator_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 316289.41 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date, org.directorate, org.division, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 6.94 OR COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) > 5.71 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, country_division_avg DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigators, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_in_directorate, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE))) AS prev_award_total FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 2609826.09 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') AND o.directorate LIKE 'ENG%' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 83170010.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 78.4 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC LIMIT 248.6;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT f.name, '; ' ORDER BY f.name) AS foa_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pe.code, '; ' ORDER BY pe.code) AS program_element_codes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pr.code, '; ' ORDER BY pr.code) AS program_reference_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS investigator_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_effective_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_expiration_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_total_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 6795775.8 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2020-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'CA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 97.69 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 416963209.76 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT f.name, '; ' ORDER BY f.name) AS foa_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pe.text, '; ' ORDER BY pe.text) AS program_element_texts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT pr.text, '; ' ORDER BY pr.text) AS program_reference_texts, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS investigator_count, AVG(a.award_amount) FILTER (WHERE a.award_amount > 0) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 7903510.67 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 88.32 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 470777696.64 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN a.award_effective_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) AS latest_effective_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_directorate FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code::character varying = pe.code JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code::character varying = pr.code WHERE a.award_amount > 2119821.24 AND (CASE WHEN a.award_effective_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2011-01-01' AND (CASE WHEN a.award_expiration_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN TO_DATE(a.award_expiration_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) > '2024-01-01' AND (CASE WHEN iva.start_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN TO_DATE(iva.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END) < '1990-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2769949.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 5.82 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, org.code AS organization_code, org.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(a.award_amount) AS max_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a3.award_id FROM awards a3 WHERE a3.award_amount > 4857029.85)) AS high_value_award_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY org.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS directorate_rank_by_total FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') AND a.award_instrument = 'Standard Grant' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, org.code, org.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 40800833.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 5.07 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 9749589.77 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (i.id, i.name, o.directorate, o.division), (i.id, i.name), (o.directorate, o.division), () ) ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id, i1.name AS institution_name, i1.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND i1.id <> i2.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON i2.id = ia2.id WHERE a.award_amount > 5027253.2 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i1.id, i1.name, i1.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 635355.52 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id_1, i2.id AS institution_id_2, i1.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) AS shared_award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_shared_award_amount FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON ia1.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id AND i1.id < i2.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id WHERE i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND a.award_amount > 556440.47 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) > 6.18 ORDER BY total_shared_award_amount DESC;

SELECT o.code AS organization_code, o.division, o.directorate, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM awards a JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount > 1261470.86 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (o.code, o.division, o.directorate, i.state_code, award_year), (o.code, o.division, o.directorate, i.state_code), (o.code, o.division, o.directorate), (o.code, o.division), (o.code), (i.state_code, award_year), (i.state_code), (award_year), () ) ORDER BY o.code NULLS LAST, o.division NULLS LAST, o.directorate NULLS LAST, i.state_code NULLS LAST, award_year NULLS LAST, total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 9314354.95 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 7276429.95 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(SUM(a.award_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3year FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 1918716.72 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 26530521.01 ORDER BY i.id, award_year;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, foa.name AS foa_name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.email_id IN (SELECT ia3.email_id FROM investigator_awards ia3 WHERE ia3.award_id = a.award_id AND ia3.role_code = 'PI')) AS investigator_count, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_rank_in_state FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info foa ON fa.code = foa.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 9973483 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'CA' AND org.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, foa.name, a.award_amount, i.state_code, org.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 4 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, award_rank_in_state;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) > 435537000.47 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 2525463.91 AND 2321554.94 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE' ELSE 'LOW_VALUE' END AS funding_tier, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) > 19.69 THEN 'DIVERSE_PROGRAM' ELSE 'FOCUSED_PROGRAM' END AS program_diversity, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_names, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 73066.0 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 39.15 AND SUM(a.award_amount) >= 539948.72 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, total_awards DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.email_id = ia.email_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS pi_count_for_investigator, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT o.directorate, '; ') AS directorates, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS funding_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards iaw ON i.id = iaw.id JOIN awards a ON iaw.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON ia.email_id = inv.id LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 7437813.77 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, ia.email_id HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 664162.57 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4191771.99 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 45591036.64 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 8144002.24 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 11358.91 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT award_id FROM awards WHERE award_amount > 919105.41) ) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'CA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 445409.68 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_award_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 8993578.12 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, a.award_amount ORDER BY i.id, a.award_effective_date;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS distinct_investigator_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS total_amount_rank, ROUND(SUM(a.award_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(a.arra_amount), 0), 2) AS award_to_arra_ratio FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 1576279.9 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') AND o.directorate LIKE 'ENG%' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code, o.directorate, f.code, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 88.95 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 61556369.2 AND AVG(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 723380.75 AND 3829276.41 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC LIMIT 614.3;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate, i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_amount_in_directorate_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) DESC) AS overall_award_count_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 7864563.74 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 951.07 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 12831481.8 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 4130263.23 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (i.id, i.name, o.directorate, o.division), (i.id, i.name), (o.directorate, o.division), () ) ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 1110890.62 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3299526.07 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.code) AS avg_award_by_org FROM awards a INNER JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code WHERE a.award_amount > 588885.35 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title, o.code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) > 8.97 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7671025.93 GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(ia.award_id) >= 8.81 INTERSECT SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id WHERE iva.role_code = 'PI' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING SUM(a.arra_amount) > 3727318.98 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 3551076.46 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'BIO' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2678121.81 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(SUM(a.award_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3year FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 6494144.6 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 9687938.29 ORDER BY i.id, award_year;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) > 3822207.48 THEN 'High Value' WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 464973.44 AND 508807.16 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS funding_category FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_instrument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 48.75 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate, i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_amount_in_directorate_state, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) DESC) AS overall_award_count_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 5711332.12 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AA' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 379.04 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 431553.87 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 913610.97 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT iva.email_id) > 5.52 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva WHERE inva.award_id = a.award_id AND inva.role_code = 'PI' ) AND a.award_effective_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 7592521 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4331724.23 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inv_a WHERE inv_a.award_id = a.award_id AND inv_a.role_code = 'PI' ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 45417611.53 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 6388730.22 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.id IN ( SELECT ia2.id FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN awards a2 ON ia2.award_id = a2.award_id WHERE a2.award_amount > 157004.67 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2004370.05 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 9299707.2 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR i.country_name = 'A') AND NOT (o.division = 'A') AND a.award_effective_date >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 65.17 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 863851234.62 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 5442305.89 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) >= 42.78 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 2323536.54 GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 23785116.91 UNION ALL SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.arra_amount IS NOT NULL AND a.arra_amount > 1265722.01 GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > 22.61 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC NULLS LAST, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 6173649.39 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'BIO' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 33683932.76 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 2613900.73 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) >= 34.35 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_award_amount, COUNT(a.award_id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_award_count, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_avg_award, o.directorate, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_reference_code, ia.zipcode, inv.first_name, inv.last_name, a.award_instrument, a.program_officer, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount_by_group, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS distinct_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id::varchar = inv.email_id WHERE a.award_amount > 5945338.31 AND a.award_effective_date::date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date::date <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, o.directorate, f.name, pe.code, pr.code, ia.zipcode, inv.first_name, inv.last_name, a.award_instrument, a.program_officer, a.award_amount, a.award_id HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 632983.59 ORDER BY rolling_30day_award_amount DESC, total_award_amount_by_group DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 7128755.41 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > 47.64 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code WHERE a.award_amount > 949748.72 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1314133.52 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id1, i2.id AS institution_id2, i1.city_name AS city1, i2.city_name AS city2, i1.state_code AS state1, i2.state_code AS state2, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.arra_amount) AS avg_arra_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_references, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_codes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank_by_amount, LAG(SUM(a.award_amount), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) DESC) AS prev_state_total FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fia.code = f.code WHERE a.award_amount > 5585487.78 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i1.state_code = i2.state_code AND i1.id <> i2.id GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.city_name, i2.city_name, i1.state_code, i2.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 22.62 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 4504142.98 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count, AVG(a.arra_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate) AS avg_arra_by_directorate FROM awards a JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 782802.95 AND (a.arra_amount IS NOT NULL OR a.award_instrument = 'Grant') AND NOT (o.division = 'BIO' AND a.award_effective_date < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 266636.46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) BETWEEN 6.89 AND 11.49 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT f.name, ', ' ORDER BY f.name) AS foa_names FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code WHERE a.award_amount > 3563940.59 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 31.25 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS percentile_75_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3872725.88 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 19224477.87 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS avg_award_amount_by_state FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3248000.26 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_amount ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS avg_award_amount_by_state FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 515580.21 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_amount ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 2944859.55 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'BIO' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > (SELECT AVG(award_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) AS award_count FROM institution_awards ia2 GROUP BY ia2.id) subq) ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 800640.47 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 134280.36 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code AS org_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_ref_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS num_institutions_per_award, COUNT(DISTINCT inva.email_id) AS num_investigators_per_award, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, o.division) AS country_division_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id WHERE ( a.award_amount > 1138083.15 OR a.arra_amount > 4634435.71 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva2 WHERE inva2.award_id = a.award_id AND inva2.role_code = 'PI' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND i2.state_code = 'CA' ) ) AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code, o.directorate, o.division, f.code, f.name, pe.code, pr.code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) > 7.71 ORDER BY award_amount_rank, state_directorate_total DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(pe.code, '_', pr.code)) AS distinct_program_element_ref_combos, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(ia.zipcode, '_', i.zipcode)) AS distinct_zip_combos, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 903223.79 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1140057.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 25.88 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.id) AS unique_investigator_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS unique_program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS unique_program_reference_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding_in_directorate, SUM(SUM(a.award_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_funding_by_state FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 9312362.07 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code, o.directorate, f.code, f.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 7.11 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 57669248.92 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC LIMIT 763.16;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE i.state_code LIKE 'A%' AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4451447.68 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 8013771.26 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > 96.29 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i_a.name AS institution_name, i_a.zipcode, a.award_effective_date, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i_a.name ORDER BY a.award_effective_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_award_amount, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i_a.name ORDER BY a.award_effective_date ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS award_count_4_period FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards i_a ON a.award_id = i_a.award_id JOIN institution i ON i_a.id = i.id WHERE a.award_amount > 7772453.17 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i_a.name, i_a.zipcode, a.award_effective_date, a.award_amount ORDER BY i_a.name, a.award_effective_date;

SELECT a.award_id, a.award_title, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS institution_count FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 16535.46 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM foa_info_awards faa WHERE faa.award_id = a.award_id AND faa.code = 69.28 ) GROUP BY a.award_id, a.award_title HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1580251.62 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 571735.39 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'BIO' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) > (SELECT AVG(award_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) AS award_count FROM institution_awards ia2 GROUP BY ia2.id) subq) ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 807860.97 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 2104399.11 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva WHERE inva.award_id = a.award_id AND inva.role_code = 'PI' ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 5579077.4 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT AVG(a2.award_amount) FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.organisation_code = o.code AND a2.award_amount > 1621754.68) AS avg_org_award_above_threshold FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 5159809.47 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7705516.08 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 21353544.57 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_year, award_quarter;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id1, i2.id AS institution_id2, i1.state_code AS state1, i2.state_code AS state2, oa.directorate, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS program_reference_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i1.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN awards a ON ia1.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization oa ON a.organisation_code = oa.code JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON a.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE i1.id <> i2.id AND a.award_amount > 4746681.42 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i1.state_code = 'AA' GROUP BY i1.id, i2.id, i1.state_code, i2.state_code, oa.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 203.75 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 3880154.1 ORDER BY total_arra_amount DESC, avg_award_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 6185423.3 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 62.66 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 1224529.38 AND (i.state_code = 'AL' OR i.country_name = 'USA') AND NOT (o.division = 'DIV1') AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 9.83 AND SUM(a.award_amount) <= 76911076.64 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 6289467.72 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) >= 47.59 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code AS org_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_ref_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_names_per_award, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS total_award_amount_by_state_dir, AVG(a.arra_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, o.division) AS avg_arra_by_country_div, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 151631.99 AND a.arra_amount BETWEEN 839946.44 AND 5493176.84 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards iva2 WHERE iva2.award_id = a.award_id AND iva2.role_code = 'PI' ) AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code, o.directorate, o.division, f.name, pe.code, pr.code, a.award_effective_date, a.award_expiration_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT inv.last_name) > 3.88 AND AVG(a.award_amount) > 290560.42 ORDER BY total_award_amount_by_state_dir DESC, award_amount_rank LIMIT 906.84;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.email_id) AS distinct_investigator_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.code) AS distinct_foa_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_element_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_reference_count, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_effective_date, MIN(CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE)) AS earliest_award_expiration_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS state_rank_by_total_amount, SUM(SUM(a.award_amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate) AS directorate_total_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards iaw ON i.id = iaw.id JOIN awards a ON iaw.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code LEFT JOIN investigator_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 8273333.01 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 8849040.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 17.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ia.email_id) > 48.32 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 7152412.1 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 9786368.77 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 590983.65 AND (i.state_code = 'AA' OR i.country_name = 'A') AND NOT (o.division = 'A') AND a.award_effective_date >= '1970-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 61.67 AND SUM(a.award_amount) < 211721156.32 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(a.award_amount) AS max_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.email_id) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id IN (SELECT ia3.award_id FROM institution_awards ia3 WHERE ia3.id = i.id) AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS investigators_with_role, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id WHERE a.award_amount > 217783 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX', 'IL') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.directorate, o.division HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 65884561 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 46 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;
