SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MIN(a.award_effective_date) AS earliest_award_date, MAX(a.award_expiration_date) AS latest_expiration_date FROM institution i INNER JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id INNER JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id LEFT JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id LEFT JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id LEFT JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id WHERE a.award_amount > 8505276.69 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3163713.14 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS funding_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4633597.54 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) >= 55.14 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 9302852.4 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 29085535.55 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_year DESC, award_quarter DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS num_program_elements, COUNT(DISTINCT pr_a.code) AS num_program_references, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, org.division) AS state_division_avg FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code WHERE a.award_amount > 8049719.23 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_id IN ( SELECT ia2.award_id FROM investigator_awards ia2 JOIN investigator inv ON ia2.email_id = inv.id WHERE ia2.role_code = 'PI' AND ia2.start_date >= '2010-01-01' ) AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, org.directorate, org.division, fi.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) > 3.78 AND AVG(a.award_amount) > 374013.42 ORDER BY state_directorate_total DESC, institution_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS distinct_awards, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.name) AS distinct_institution_names, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.code) AS distinct_program_element_codes, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.code) AS distinct_program_reference_codes, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 422599.18 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'NY', 'TX') AND o.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, o.code, o.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 24.68 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 6759245.72 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, distinct_awards DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 8691282.5 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 41116181.92 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE i.state_code LIKE 'A%' AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 1184090.61 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_award_total, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.id ORDER BY a.award_effective_date::date RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 9466838.81 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_effective_date, a.award_amount ORDER BY i.id, a.award_effective_date;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, org.code AS organization_code, org.directorate, org.division, foa.code AS foa_code, foa.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_reference_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, SUM(a.arra_amount) AS total_arra_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT inv.email_id) AS distinct_investigator_count, GROUPING(i.id, i.state_code, i.country_name, org.code, org.directorate, org.division, foa.code, pe.code, pr.code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AS grouping_id FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id JOIN institution i ON ia.id = i.id JOIN organization org ON a.organisation_code = org.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info foa ON fa.code = foa.code JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 9313844.16 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'CA', 'CA') AND org.directorate = 'ENG' GROUP BY CUBE( i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, org.code, org.directorate, org.division, foa.code, foa.name, pe.code, pr.code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 6263767.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 73.33 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC, grouping_id;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 9461415.55 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND o.directorate = 'BIO' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 97.19 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 3191538.99 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 42872967.97 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_year, award_quarter;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code AS org_code, o.directorate, o.division, f.code AS foa_code, f.name AS foa_name, pe.code AS program_element_code, pr.code AS program_ref_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) AS num_institutions_per_award, COUNT(DISTINCT inva.email_id) AS num_investigators_per_award, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_directorate_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.country_name, o.division) AS country_division_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.award_amount DESC) AS award_amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id AND i.zipcode = ia.zipcode JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id LEFT JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = pe.id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = pr.id LEFT JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id WHERE ( a.award_amount > 4321853.3 OR a.arra_amount > 2042559.11 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva2 WHERE inva2.award_id = a.award_id AND inva2.role_code = 'PI' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM institution_awards ia2 JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND i2.state_code = 'CA' ) ) AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, i.country_name, a.award_id, a.award_title, a.award_amount, a.arra_amount, o.code, o.directorate, o.division, f.code, f.name, pe.code, pr.code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia.id) > 8.73 ORDER BY award_amount_rank, state_directorate_total DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards inva WHERE inva.award_id = a.award_id AND inva.role_code = 'PI' ) AND a.award_effective_date >= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 4376720 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 759686.59 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 40846633.71 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 648006.4 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND i.state_code IN (SELECT state_code FROM institution WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 34.9) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 3817443.74 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = ia.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI') AS pi_count_per_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_amount > 4931368.01 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, ia.award_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT inva.email_id) > 4.62 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 3778707.5 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 42708330.88 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i1.id AS institution_id, i1.name AS institution_name, i2.id AS other_institution_id, i2.name AS other_institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) AS shared_award_count FROM institution i1 JOIN institution_awards ia1 ON i1.id = ia1.id JOIN institution_awards ia2 ON ia1.award_id = ia2.award_id JOIN institution i2 ON ia2.id = i2.id WHERE i1.id < i2.id AND ia1.award_id IN (SELECT a.award_id FROM awards a WHERE a.award_amount > 950658.67) GROUP BY i1.id, i1.name, i2.id, i2.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ia1.award_id) > 3.58 ORDER BY shared_award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id::character varying = inv.email_id WHERE a.award_amount > 8633852.41 GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > (SELECT AVG(a2.award_amount) FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 1590580.43) ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code AS org_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) AS num_program_elements, SUM(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code, o.directorate) AS state_dir_total, AVG(a.award_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY i.state_code) AS state_avg_award FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fia ON a.award_id = fia.award_id JOIN foa_info fi ON fia.code = fi.code LEFT JOIN program_element_awards pe_a ON a.award_id = pe_a.award_id LEFT JOIN program_reference_awards pr_a ON a.award_id = pr_a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 4180859.83 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 48.08 ) AND i.state_code IN ('CA', 'TX') GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, a.award_id, a.award_amount, a.award_effective_date, o.code, o.directorate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pe_a.code) > 2.03 AND SUM(a.award_amount) > 3579544.26 ORDER BY state_dir_total DESC, num_program_elements DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_expiration_date <= '2000-01-01' AND a.award_amount > 3542535.18 GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 4.73 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_amount, CASE WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) > 3747025.89 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN SUM(a.award_amount) BETWEEN 827593.03 AND 821506.88 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE' ELSE 'LOW_VALUE' END AS funding_tier, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) > 52.46 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code WHERE a.award_amount > 4880954.22 AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards ia2 JOIN investigator inv ON ia2.email_id = inv.id WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM foa_info_awards fa JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code WHERE fa.award_id = a.award_id AND f.name ILIKE '%Research%' ) ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 414078.2 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, o.code AS organization_code, o.directorate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.arra_amount) AS avg_arra_amount, MAX(CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE)) AS latest_award_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.directorate ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS rank_by_funding FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN organization o ON a.organisation_code = o.code JOIN foa_info_awards fa ON a.award_id = fa.award_id JOIN foa_info f ON fa.code = f.code JOIN investigator_awards iva ON a.award_id = iva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON iva.email_id = CAST(inv.email_id AS INTEGER) JOIN program_element_awards pea ON a.award_id = pea.award_id JOIN program_element pe ON pea.code = CAST(pe.code AS INTEGER) JOIN program_reference_awards pra ON a.award_id = pra.award_id JOIN program_reference pr ON pra.code = CAST(pr.code AS INTEGER) WHERE a.award_amount > 35337.93 AND CAST(a.award_effective_date AS DATE) >= '2000-01-01' AND CAST(a.award_expiration_date AS DATE) <= '2005-01-01' AND i.state_code = 'AL' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, o.code, o.directorate HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 28219690.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) >= 71.1 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC, award_count DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS award_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 298727.75 AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= '2000-01-01' AND TO_DATE(a.award_effective_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code, award_year, award_quarter HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 53648699.12 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, AVG(a.award_amount) AS avg_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 2349117.06 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM investigator_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.award_id = a.award_id AND ia2.role_code = 'PI' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 37.73 ) GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 20233465.94 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT a.award_id, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM awards a JOIN institution_awards ia ON a.award_id = ia.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 26951.58 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY a.award_id ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS median_award_amount, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.award_amount) AS p75_award_amount FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 5271864.83 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 35393017.18 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.award_amount) DESC) AS amount_rank FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_amount > 1420140.12 AND a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 16508394.69 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, i.state_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.award_id) AS total_awards, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia2.award_id) FROM institution_awards ia2 WHERE ia2.id = i.id AND ia2.award_id IN (SELECT a2.award_id FROM awards a2 WHERE a2.award_amount > 728126.43)) AS high_value_award_count FROM institution i JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id JOIN investigator_awards inva ON a.award_id = inva.award_id JOIN investigator inv ON inva.email_id = inv.id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.state_code HAVING SUM(a.award_amount) > 438605.16 ORDER BY total_award_amount DESC;

SELECT i.id AS institution_id, i.name AS institution_name, COUNT(ia.award_id) AS award_count, SUM(a.award_amount) AS total_award_amount FROM institution i LEFT JOIN institution_awards ia ON i.id = ia.id LEFT JOIN awards a ON ia.award_id = a.award_id WHERE a.award_effective_date >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY i.id, i.name HAVING COUNT(ia.award_id) < 64.69 ORDER BY award_count ASC, total_award_amount DESC;
